paragraphs.heading: Wrapping up science
paragraphs.edited: So we've almost made it through science. We've discovered that science is really a foundation for understanding our world, and that it does not contradict our faith. Well, that's good news. We've also taken a look at three really good pieces of evidence that help us see that God is actually there — that we have evidence for God. We looked at the idea of fine-tuning, we looked at the idea of DNA, and we looked at the idea of design. All of these point to God in some way, shape, or form through the use of science.

paragraphs.heading: Why we do this study
paragraphs.edited: Now remember the reason why we're doing this study. It's so that our students can have a deep conviction for themselves about what they believe and why they believe it, and also be able to communicate that in love and humility, and do so relationally. So while it might be really exciting to have some eager students ready to get started and to get engaged in conversation, help them be patient, because there is so much more to learn.
